audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits 51.9% WR over 4919 games; lane duel is Syndra's, the difficulty is macro — following Destiny roams — and the prose says exactly that.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had only 3 entries (packet defect) and content whys[3..5] were shifted one stage: the Levels 4-5 row explained Level 6, the Level 6 row explained first item, the First item row explained mid-game.
audit.why: Each why must describe its own labelled stage or the chart reads wrong even when the side is right.
audit.corrected: whys[3..5] realigned to their stages; spikes[3] (Late) created with before:null using kit-verified numbers (Destiny 170s rank 1, 5500 range).

audit.whatIsWrong: The auto-reset tell on Pick a Card (missingInteractions) was nowhere on the page, breakdown.cooldowns had no digit, and two bullets were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim.
audit.why: TF's combo opens with a W auto-reset — the wind-up, not the cast, is the dodge cue; gold card is 200 range and 6s cooldown, Wild Cards 6s>5s, which is the whole sequencing of the lane.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field rewritten with 6s W, 6s>5s Q, 170s R and the auto-reset tell; bleed bullets replaced with gold-card-range and Stacked Deck facts.

edits.before: Level 6 Syndra's R gives her lethal all-in burst; even accounting for TF's global ult, her direct lane dominance holds.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 Syndra keeps chunking TF whenever he steps to farm; his gold card needs 200 range he never safely gets.

edits.before: First-item Syndra fixes her mana and out-trades a low-DPS utility TF with Q poke plus QE.
edits.after: Level 6 Syndra's R is lethal burst; TF's Destiny is map pressure, not a duel, so lane stays hers.

edits.before: Mid-game teamfights favor Syndra's point-and-click R burst over TF's fragile, low-damage kit.
edits.after: First item fixes her mana and Luden's out-trades a low-DPS utility TF with Q poke plus QE.

TF stays one of the squishiest carries in the game: your QE into R deletes him before a gold card lands. His Destiny flanks are the only threat — respect the 5500-range Gate, ward the flanks, and force fights while it sits on its 170-second cooldown.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Scatter the Weak has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is a 6s cooldown and his combo opens with it as an auto-reset — the yellow-glow wind-up is your back-off cue, not the throw. - Wild Cards is 6s down to 5: sidestep it and he has no poke for the window. - Destiny is 170s at rank 1 — while it is down, shove and roam-follow freely. - Your E is for the gank.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, W-slow the dodge attempt, QE the slowed line, Q again — a full bar of damage that started as routine poke.
edits.after: Gold card is a 200-range point-and-click stun — E him back the moment he walks up with it locked and the gank setup collapses.

edits.before: Spending E on chip-spacing and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive unanswered — the stun is the matchup, not the damage.
edits.after: Stacked Deck's fourth attack plus a gold card adds up — TF wins the shuffle-poke if you stand still counting spheres; keep moving.

edits.before: The chart below maps the swing points — neither side owns this lane until a spike says so.
edits.after: The chart is Syndra's at every stage — TF never gets a lane window; his game lives in his roams.
